    • findConflictsWithApplications

      @Query("select new edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.models.DraftConflict(d.email, d.id, a.id) from draft_applications d, applications a where d.recruitmentId = :recruitmentId and a.recruitmentId = d.recruitmentId and a.email = d.email and a.status <> :excluded order by d.email, a.id") List<DraftConflict> findConflictsWithApplications(@Param("recruitmentId") Long recruitmentId, @Param("excluded") ApplicationReviewStatus excluded)
      Issue #417: every student with both a draft and an application to one recruitment, leaving out the applications with status excluded (CANCELLED: one who cancelled may start again). One row per draft and application pair, by email and then application id. A join in the database, so nothing but the conflicts is loaded.
